Subject: SKU ledger verification + next-step list

Hi team,

Quick ask to support finance close and our Q4 forecast: can we run a short, focused verification on all open ACME deals targeted to close this quarter (close date in HubSpot between 11/15 and 12/31)? The goal is to ensure amount, product/SKU, next step, and probability are accurate in HubSpot so FP&A can finalize the forecast.

Scope & expectations:
- Start with deals > $25k ARR; if you can triage > $50k first that helps.
- For each deal verify these fields in HubSpot: Amount, SKU/Product lines, Next step (specific owner action), Close probability.
- Flag any discrepancies where the SKU in the CRM does not match the SKU codes in the attached sku_matrix_Q4.csv.
- Confirm if billing/PO language or AM/PO numbers are needed from the customer.

Attachments: sku_matrix_Q4.csv (reference SKU canonical list), acme_mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (current MAP we shared).

Please update the deal record or drop a one-line comment in the sheet (link below) by EOD Tuesday 11/10. If you need help reconciling particular product lines I can jump on a 30-min triage slot — I opened a few 11/10 windows on my calendar.

HubSpot filter (for convenience): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345
CRM working sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDeFgHIjKlmnopQrsTxyz

Why this matters: FP&A needs an accurate commit file by 11/12 to lock revenue guidance for the board materials. Small SKU mismatches have been the biggest source of variance in the last two quarters.

Thanks — please drop acknowledgements in thread so I can track coverage.

—
Ava Chen
